scope: Admin league/tournament roster local member-selection requirement and cancel recovery
browser: Cloud Chromium; supported browser DOM observations and native window resize/browser zoom
auth: Existing administrator shell rendered; no sign-in/out or role change
passes: League empty registration has seven eligible choices. At each of three widths: placeholder selected and Add disabled; local member choice enables Add; reopen after dismissal resets placeholder/Add disabled and roster stays empty.
League dismissal matrix: mobile Escape; tablet footer Close; desktop X. Focus returns to original review trigger.

Tournament one-player registration has two eligible choices. Same local selection/Add gate/reset at each width; mobile footer Close, tablet Escape, desktop X. No addition confirmed; same one-player row observed after reopen.

Existing-player duplicate restriction: all six existing league members disabled in option list with already-in-roster reason; tournament existing one member disabled while two other members remain eligible. This validates member dedup availability, not duplicate jersey-number validation.
Latest50 captured warn/error sample:50 browser-extension metadata errors and0 application-origin entries. Not full network/health proof.
findings: No new independent defect. Known initial focus staying on background review trigger remains observed; not duplicated.
limits: Admin review forms expose member picker and per-player qualification selects; no real-name, phone, birthday or jersey inputs. Required-field presence is implemented by disabled Add with no native required attr; this is not classified as defect.

Jersey min/max and duplicate-jersey local validation cannot be exercised through these administrator review forms. Existing prior app-roster jersey100 test had four other missing required fields and cannot establish isolated range validation. It was not repeated.
Qualification selects have no separate Save control; treated as immediate-write risk and never changed. No claim that autosave implementation was technically verified.
No Save/Add/Exclude/lock/exception/status/result/permission/notification controls activated. No QA179, new fixture, application flow, paid/closed application retry, file upload or export.
Individual-match roster input form was not newly opened in this bounded continuation; attendance draft/cancel was already covered in previous batch.
No physical mobile/tablet, virtual keyboard, screen reader or cross-browser check.
Two proof observations are explicitly excluded: offscreen navigation dialog matched instead of roster; row-loading state captured before settled data. Later valid observations supply evidence.
